data.ruling: The refutation does not stand. The stock verifier confirmed every sourcing and lifecycle figure. The datasheet verifier's two failed checks are not failures of the part. (1) 'watchdog window (V1, V2)': the verifier's own reading shows that the silicon sets any timeout up to 0xffffff, about 16 s. That range covers every timeout either bound could ask for, including one above the 900 ms stall. The window is empty only because the stall found for V2 (900 ms, from a 400 ms packaged-part sector erase plus a 500 ms blocking USB console write) exceeds the stop deadline found for V1 (200 ms). That conflict sits between two values of the specification and the firmware. It would also empty the window for any other microcontroller, so it cannot refute this one. (2) 'image watchdog timeout (V4)': the coprocessor image sets no timeout. This is a firmware fact, and IOBoard.md:221 already records it ('The image enables none yet'). It says nothing about the RP2354B. Research.md P4 lists R1's watchdog findings among the figures that are re-read 'for a decision or for P5', not among the part's requirement values. Research.md:42-43 makes the RP2354B a fixed input: it is checked for stock, lifecycle and a second source, and a failed check goes to the owner, not to re-selection. All three checks pass. JLCPCB stock is 2985 against a gate of 50, and 20 parts are held against a need of 5. Digi-Key has 3560 of SC1512(13)-A4, status Active. PCN 28 declares end of life only for the non-A4 steppings. The RP2354B stays. Both findings still reach the owner and P5 as figures: the empty V1/V2 window (200 ms deadline against a 900 ms stall, with the sector erase alone at 400 ms) and the missing image timeout (V4).
data.evidence: RP2350 datasheet build 2025-07-29 (build-version d126e9e-clean, SHA-256 2877d0f270fb6d6a57943bee58aaad536aa027bea1e5b1c4ce2541a3230d4be8), WATCHDOG LOAD register bits 23:0: 'The maximum setting is 0xffffff which corresponds to approximately 16 seconds' (text lines 90234-90235 and 90318-90319 of pdftotext output). grep -rn -i watchdog of firmware/iomcu/ at c25aa863372d finds only comments at src/main.c:970-973 and no watchdog call. IOBoard.md:221 states the timeout exceeds the 400 ms sector erase and that the image enables no watchdog. IOBoard.md:186 gives the 200 ms deadline of the monostable path, and docs/Safety.md:13 the 200 ms link failsafe. Research.md:561, 562 and 564 mark V1, V2 and V4 'for research (owner, 2026-09-28)', so they are found values, not requirement values the owner set. Research.md:42-43 is the fixed-input rule. Research.md P4 row: 'R1's crystal tolerance, BOOT resistor, OpenOCD and watchdog findings' are re-read as figures for a decision or for P5. The stock verifier's readings, all passing: JLCPCB C39843328 stockCount 2985, canPresaleNumber 2828 at 13:45:07Z; Digi-Key SC1512(13)-A4 Active, 3560 in stock at 13:45:12Z; held 20 (inventory-2026-09-25.csv).
